sentences.text: Under International rules, when vessels are in sight of one another, a power-driven vessel underway that is maneuvering as authorized or required by the rules shall indicate that maneuver by whistle.
One short blast means I am altering my course to starboard.
Two short blasts means I am altering my course to port.
Three short blasts means I am operating astern propulsion.
These signals describe action actually being taken, and no reply is required.
A vessel may supplement them with light signals on an all-round white light.
Each flash lasts about one second, flashes are about one second apart, and successive signals are at least ten seconds apart.
